Collection Description
# MERN CRM API - Postman test suite (Assignment 14) End-to-end tests for the Express 5 + Mongoose CRM API: health, JWT auth, customer CRUD, search/filter, validation and error handling, and per-user data isolation. Every request has assertions on the HTTP status **and** the JSON body. ## Prerequisites - MongoDB running and the API started (`npm run server` from the project root) on **http://localhost:5014**. - Environment **MERN CRM - Local** (`postman/MERN-CRM.postman_environment.json`) which sets `baseUrl = http://localhost:5014/api`. ## Run in Postman.app 1. **Import** `postman/MERN-CRM.postman_collection.json` and `postman/MERN-CRM.postman_environment.json`. 2. Select the **MERN CRM - Local** environment (top right). 3. Open the collection, click **Run**, keep the default order (folders 0 to 4), then **Run MERN CRM API**. Requests depend on each other (tokens and ids are saved by earlier requests), so run the whole collection in order. To send requests by hand, send "0. Health" and "1. Auth / Register user A" first. ## Run from the command line (newman) From the project root: ```bash npm run test:api # same as npx newman run postman/MERN-CRM.postman_collection.json -e postman/MERN-CRM.postman_environment.json # HTML report (newman-reporter-htmlextra) npx -y -p newman@6 -p newman-reporter-htmlextra newman run postman/MERN-CRM.postman_collection.json \ -e postman/MERN-CRM.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra \ --reporter-htmlextra-export postman/newman-report.html ``` ## How it works - **Re-runnable:** the collection-level pre-request script creates a unique `runId` (`Date.now()`) only when one is not already set for this run, and "0. Health" (the first request) starts every run with a fresh `runId` and clears values left over from a previous run. All user emails contain `runId`, so the suite can run any number of times against the same database. - **Runtime values** are stored with `pm.collectionVariables` (works in Postman.app and newman without exporting an environment): `token`, `tokenB`, `userId`, `userIdB`, `emailA`, `customerId`, `customerId2`, `customerId3`, `customerIdB`, ... - **Auth:** collection-level Bearer `{{token}}` (user A). Public and negative requests use *No Auth*; user B requests override it with `{{tokenB}}`. - **Common checks** (collection-level test script) on every response: JSON content type, `success` flag matches the HTTP status, error responses carry a message and never leak a stack trace. - **Cleanup:** the last requests of "4. Security & Misc" delete every customer created by the run and verify both users have 0 customers. The two test users remain (the API has no delete-user endpoint). ## Folders 0. Health - API and database are up. 1. Auth - register / login / profile, including validation, duplicate email, wrong credentials and missing/garbage tokens. 2. Customers - CRUD - create, list (newest first), search, status filter, get, update, delete, 404 after delete. 3. Customers - Validation & Errors - 400 field errors, 409 duplicates, malformed ids (400), unknown ids (404), invalid query params. 4. Security & Misc - user isolation (user B vs user A), missing/forged/unsigned tokens, unknown route, malformed and oversized JSON, cleanup.
